name: Targoyle
biography: Pice fumanima. A tar-bodied elemental gargoyle. Heating its core (10+ Fire damage) drops its AC to 15 but grants a Fly Speed of 20 feet, ignites its Bite, and unlocks its Heat Beam — a trade attackers may regret triggering. Habitat: Mountain & Planar.

features.name: Heated Core
features.description: If the targoyle takes 10+ Fire damage in a single instance, its core becomes heated for 1 minute, until the targoyle is submerged in water, or until it takes 10+ Cold damage in a single instance. While its core is heated, the targoyle takes a -2 penalty to AC (AC 15), it gains a Fly Speed of 20 feet, its Bite attack deals extra Fire damage on a hit (included in the attack), and it can use its Heat Beam action.

features.name: Tar Splatter
features.description: The first time each turn when the targoyle takes Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, it bursts in an eruption of scalding tar. Saving Throw: DC 16 Dexterity, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the targoyle. Failure: The target is coated in tar until it or a creature within reach of it takes an action to remove the tar. While coated in tar, a creature's Speed is reduced by 15 feet. If a creature coated in tar takes Fire damage, it takes an extra 9 (2d8) Fire damage and is no longer coated in tar.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The targoyle makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

features.name: Bite
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Fire damage if the targoyle's core is heated (see Heated Core trait).

features.name: Claw
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage, and the target is coated in tar as if it failed the saving throw against the Targoyle's Tar Splatter trait.

features.name: Tar Shot (Recharge 5-6)
features.description: The targoyle hurls a ball of tar at a point it can see within 60 feet of itself. Saving Throw: DC 16 Dexterity, each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centred on the point. Failure: 28 (8d6) Bludgeoning damage, and the creature is coated in tar as if it failed the saving throw against the Targoyle's Tar Splatter trait. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: Ground in the area becomes Difficult Terrain for 1 minute.

features.name: Heat Beam (Recharge 6; Only While its Core is Heated)
features.description: Saving Throw: DC 16 Dexterity, each creature in a 100-foot long, 10-foot wide Line. Failure: 35 (10d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: The targoyle's core is no longer heated.
